//: Deliberately standalone, for the same reason as src/wire/tsconfig.json:
RemoteSession inside the desktop's vitest run, which loads the nearest
tsconfig.json for every file it transforms. The parent mobile/tsconfig.json
extends `expo/tsconfig.base`, which only resolves once `npm ci` has run in
mobile/ -- and the root unit job never does. Without this file that job dies
with TSCONFIG_ERROR before a single assertion runs.
Options are src/wire's, so a file that typechecks under
`npm --prefix mobile run typecheck` typechecks here too, and `types: []`
keeps the network layer from quietly growing a dependency on @types/jest or
